C0240.title: University Student Sentenced for Distributing Child Obscene Videos via Hidden Networks
C0240.summary: In 2016, Beijing police, acting on a Ministry of Public Security lead forwarded from U.S. law enforcement, cracked Beijing's first case involving the distribution of child obscene videos through overseas hidden websites. University student Sun used hidden network spaces to post such videos and also bought and shared related content through QQ groups and Baidu Cloud links. The court found that from September 2015 to March 2016 he uploaded video files, 40 of which were identified as obscene materials, and sentenced him to one year and six months in prison for distributing obscene materials; the Beijing No. 3 Intermediate People's Court upheld the judgment on appeal.
